best_parts: node lump_excision: names the surgery-first model ('surgery before a diagnosis') as a partial distractor with its own repair, a wrong model that is not on the trap map and still separates diagnosis from operation
node hook_why / hook_ovary / hook_cervix: sure_note on each confident miss, plus 'Show me why' agency path to a full explanation
node imaging_ok: adds dense-breast reasoning to the age qualifier, so the correct pick teaches a reason, not only a rule
flaws: node hook_ovary: 'Carcinoma ovary' is tagged kind trap TR4, but the trap map lists ovary as a partial neighbour of cervix; the trap label misstates which wrong model it tests
node hook: TR4 is tested only once in this segment (recognition form); no contrast form is offered here, so the old-key wrong model is not re-probed within S1
node lump_q: only the TR1 option is a true trap; the excision option is labelled partial but gets a full paragraph of feedback, which spends words on a non-trap

best_parts: node gate_partial: 'Carcinoma ovary' tagged partial, with feedback naming the wrong model ('common female cancer, but it does not lead the list') and an agency path; matches the trap map exactly

node tissue_partial and tissue_reveal: incision biopsy is a partial distractor with a specific refutation ('does give tissue, but not the preferred test'), and the reveal states what the pathologist must receive
node vig_t17: sure_note tied to the age qualifier, then a reveal that teaches the age rule as the exam cue
flaws: node gate: TR4 is probed once in this segment (recognition form); a second form in S1 would give the old-key trap an in-segment retest
node gate_t4 and tissue_t1: the first miss gives 'Try again' and an agency reveal but no second explanation in a different form; the hint ladder jumps from hint to reveal
node triple: a recap with no probe; the segment's last node is a tell with no retrieval of the triple-assessment order

best_parts: node recheck: a contrast probe ('An old exam key says cervix...') that gives TR4 a second form in the same segment, the only variant to retest the old-key trap before leaving S1
node cancer_ok: adds the upper-outer-quadrant and NST facts as a short follow-on from the correct answer, so a correct pick teaches more than the key
node close: the one-line rule 'when an old key disagrees with today's practice, answer with today's practice' is a clean, portable takeaway
flaws: node lump and img and cancer: each probe has only two options (the key and one trap) plus hint, so a learner can guess by elimination and the retry is a coin toss; there is no third or partial distractor
node cancer_t4, lump_t1, img_t17: a wrong pick goes to 'Try again' with no 'Show me why' or second explanation, so the learner who misses is shown the same question again with no new technique
node lump: the only wrong option is FNAC; the surgery-first and excision models are not offered, so the probe does not separate wrong models beyond one

merge_ideas: b's partial-labelled distractors and tissue_reveal, with c's recheck contrast probe as a second in-segment form for TR4, and a's excision partial as a third option on the lump probe
a's sure_note and 'Show me why' agency on every trap node, applied to c's two-option probes once a third distractor is added
a's hook_why full reveal used as the fallback after two misses on each probe, so every trap has the explanation and a re-test in the same segment
